title: James Lounger #23 Per-Lounger Shard / Persistent Child / Carrier Audit

gate.question: Can Lounger #23 be bound to a unique persistent child, linked reference, container, token, alias, session object or carrier-associated storage object that would constitute a James-specific persisted state source?
gate.passed: Vault 112 architecture establishes a central Think Machine 3600r plus smaller per-lounger computers, so a James-specific local processing shard is architecturally expected for Lounger #23.
gate.open: No primary/indexed shipped record reviewed exposes a unique James-specific storage child, linked carrier reference, session token, container, alias or persistent memory object behind Lounger #23.

role: runs the main Tranquility Lane simulation

per_lounger_subsystems.finding: Vault 112 descriptions state that the mainframe appears linked to several smaller computers, one handling each lounger's graphics processing and its occupant's medical status.
per_lounger_subsystems.interpretation: The shipped architecture is not purely monolithic: each lounger has a local processing/monitoring shard connected to the shared backend.

dad_monitor_is_not_dynamic_memory_store.finding: The Dad monitor displays static NOTE assets for status/stress data. No memory read/export operation is exposed there.

dad_pod_script_is_not_storage_script.finding: MQ04DadPodScript only gates activation and displays authorization/occupied messages; it exposes no storage, persistence or carrier operations.

player_container_is_not_shared_james_sto.finding: MQ04PlayerContainerScript restores only the player's inventory/state and separately reactivates Dad; it is not a shared father/child persistence object.

searched_classes_or_surfaces: Vault 112 terminal records and raw terminal dumps
persistent_child_search.limitation: A full binary Fallout3.esm/xEdit reference-graph traversal was not available in this session. Absence in indexed public dumps is not proof of absence from every record class.

carrier_boundary.reason: Pinkerton removed from Braun a mem chip that already contained an unknown person's memories and later integrated those memories into A3-21.

resident_id_anomaly.modern_transcript: Lounger #23 is shown as RESIDENT ID 642 -- UNKNOWN while T. Dithers is also shown as Resident 642 in current community transcript material.
resident_id_anomaly.older_raw_transcript: Older/raw-oriented transcript material for the Dad terminal reports UNKNOWN without a stable 642 binding.
resident_id_anomaly.rule: Do not bind James to Dithers or Resident 642 without direct ESM record/reference evidence.

save_james_effect.improvement: The search space is narrowed from the whole Think Machine/Braun backend to the local processing shard associated with James's distinct Lounger #23 endpoint.
save_james_effect.reason: No unique James-specific persistence/storage object has yet been bound to the Lounger #23 shard.

allowed: Vault 112 uses a shared simulation-control mainframe with per-lounger local processing/monitoring components.
James has a distinct Lounger #23 endpoint and distinct Doc representation.
The next strongest search target is the reference graph of the local Lounger #23 processing shard rather than its static monitor UI.
not_allowed: Lounger #23 is proven to contain James's memory backup.
Each Vault 112 lounger is proven to have a removable memory chip.
James and Dithers are proven to share Resident ID 642.
SAVE JAMES has reached asset-level executable or persisted-memory status.

next_gate.name: LOUNGER23_LOCAL_PROCESSOR_REFERENCE_GRAPH_AND_PERSISTENT_CHILD_AUDIT
required_evidence: Full xEdit/ESM enumeration of placed references in Vault112a around Lounger #23
Base and placed FormIDs for the small computer/local processor associated with Dad's lounger
Enable-parent, linked-ref, ownership, persistent-child and script attachments for that local processor
Any container/token/quest alias/session variable uniquely reachable from that processor
Any path from that object graph to Braun memory-control records or the mem-chip carrier class
next_gate.promotion_condition: A unique James-bound persistent storage/session object reachable from the Lounger #23 local processor promotes SAVE JAMES to PERSISTED_JAMES_STATE_CANDIDATE.
